supporting_features.feature_phrase: dense bed of randomly tangled filament
supporting_features.evidence: A broad mass of overlapping loops and curved strands covers the visible build-plate area.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: filament loops rising above the deposited mass
supporting_features.evidence: Several loose strands arch upward near the nozzle and along the left side of the tangle.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: absence of a coherent printed outline
supporting_features.evidence: The visible material has no continuous wall or stable geometric body and instead forms an irregular spread.
